description: This file implements HTTP Negotiate authentication handling for the cURL library, including functions for processing incoming headers, generating authentication tokens, and cleaning up negotiate state.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_input_negotiate(struct Curl_easy * data,struct connectdata * conn,bool proxy,const char * header)
methods.description: Processes the 'Negotiate' header from the server and initializes or updates the negotiation state accordingly.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_output_negotiate(struct Curl_easy * data,struct connectdata * conn,bool proxy)
methods.description: Generates the 'Negotiate' header for the client request, manages state transitions, and handles the creation of authentication tokens.

methods.name: void Curl_http_auth_cleanup_negotiate(struct connectdata * conn)
methods.description: Resets and cleans up the negotiation state and associated resources.

ctags.name: Curl_input_negotiate
ctags.signature: (struct Curl_easy * data,struct connectdata * conn,bool proxy,const char * header)
